questions.prompt: Unlike energy, nutrients such as nitrogen and carbon are…
Explain, using energy, why a vegetarian diet can feed more people from the same farmland than a diet with lots of meat.
questions.modelAnswer: When people eat plants, they get the energy directly from producers. When plants are fed to animals first, about 90% of the energy is used by the animals for living and lost as heat, so only about 10% ends up in the meat. The same land can therefore feed several times more people with plant food than with meat.
rubric: Conclusion about land and people fed
